Example Baking Notes

Buttermilk Cornbread

4.8 from 12 votes

By Jo Example

Yield: Serves 9 · Prep: 10 min

Ingredients

  • 1 cup yellow cornmeal
  • 1 cup all-purpose flour
  • ¼ cup sugar
  • 1 tablespoon baking powder
  • ½ teaspoon salt
  • 1 cup buttermilk
  • 1 large egg
  • ⅓ cup butter, melted

Instructions

  1. Heat the oven and grease a square pan.
  2. Stir the dry ingredients, then the wet ones, and bake.

Great with chili.
